author: Inside Edition
description: Large chunks of ice are covering New York's Hudson River. Ferries travelling between New York and New Jersey have been cancelled because they are not equipped to navigate the partially frozen waterway. Many people are trying to clear snow from their roofs but it is important to be cautious. 12-year-old Mariel Hadfield found herself buried in a heap of snow just outside Boston. She spoke with Inside Edition.
title: Huge Chunks Of Ice Cover New York's Hudson River

author: Inside Edition
description: New video of Alex Pretti is sparking intense debate. It was recorded 11 days before the ICU nurse was shot to death. It shows Pretti cursing at ICE agents, and kicking their SUV, breaking the taillight. The agents swarmed Pretti and let him go after a scuffle. Pretti reportedly suffered a broken rib in the confrontation. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump's border czar Tom Homan, who was brought in to Minneapolis, says ICE is changing their tactics in the city.
title: New Video Of Alex Pretti 11 Days Before His Killing Sparks Debate

author: Inside Edition
description: Brendan Banfield took the stand and claimed his wife was stabbed to death by an intruder, not him. He claimed he came home to find the stranger raping his wife, Christine. Prosecutors say Banfield lured a stranger to his home for a sexual encounter with his wife. Prosecutors say Banfield shot Joseph Ryan and stabbed his wife to death, making it appear she had been attacked by a stranger. Banfield was having an affair with the family's nanny, Juliana, who testified her role in the elaborate plot.
title: Brendan Banfield Says His Wife Was Stabbed By Intruder On Stand

author: Inside Edition
description: Police say a pregnant woman was stabbed 70 times in a dispute over the condition of a pickup truck she and her husband had sold through Facebook Marketplace. Police say after stabbing Eliza Morales and her unborn child to death, the buyer, Nedas Revuckas, set her apartment ablaze. In Missouri, decorated Marine Michael Burke was fatally shot at his home during a Facebook Marketplace deal to sell his iPhone. Inside Edition got tips on how to stay safe during Facebook Marketplace transactions.
title: Pregnant Woman Fatally Stabbed Over Facebook Marketplace Dispute

author: Inside Edition
description: Taryn Smith set out on a mission to be the first American woman to row solo across the Atlantic Ocean. On December 14, Smith set out on her 3,000-mile journey from the Canary Islands to Antigua. The 25-year-old yoga instructor from Nebraska kept a video diary of her adventure on the high seas. On Thursday, after 46 days, 3 hours, and 37 minutes at sea, Smith accomplished her mission. Cheers erupted as Smith returned to dry ground.
title: Taryn Smith, 1st American Woman To Row Solo Across Atlantic Ocean

author: Inside Edition
description: Michigan State Troopers were on the lookout for Dolly Parton. No, not that one, but as an ode to the music legend, a farmer gave the name to one of his miniature donkeys. Said donkey seemed to get loose from the farm and took a walk down a roadway. It wasn't difficult for authorities to locate the wayward animal, who they say wasn't quite ready to go home. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Donkey Named Dolly Parton Tracked Down By Troopers After Escaping Farm

author: Inside Edition
description: FedEx specializes in deliveries, but even this one caught them by surprise. An employee in Des Moines gave birth right on the floor while she was at work. Even more surprising, Amethyst Blumberg says she didn't even know she was pregnant! The mom tells KCCI that she's been pregnant before and didn't have any of the symptoms she did the first time around and she claims she lost weight during the past several months. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: FedEx Worker Didn't Know She Was Pregnant Until She Gave Birth At Work

author: Inside Edition
description: TV talk show giant Maury Povich was at the center of real-life paternity dramas, revealing the results of DNA tests his male guests had taken. The kids are being called "Maury Babies" and there are thousands of them. Inside Edition spoke to Melissa Santillan, who was 17 years old when she appeared on the show and her now 25-year-old daughter Reanna. Povich is among the daytime TV hosts featured in a three-part ABC documentary "Dirty Talk: When Daytime Talk Shows Ruled TV."
title: Where Are The Kids Who Were On 'Maury' Now?
